Carrying forward the legacy of his father, he has made Dr. Trivedi’s Homeopathy Clinic a symbol of hope and healing not just in Raipur, but across India and abroad.

formula_master.title: Quick Prescription Formula Master
formula_master.subtitle: Loaded formula rules for your login session will be managed here. Saving/activating will instantly update your current session.
formula_master.help_basics_desc: Formula sets define the master rules for parsing doctor notes and quick entries during patient consultations.
formula_master.help_basics_name_detail: Name your formula set (e.g. "Default Quick Formula") to organize different pricing or dosage rules for your clinic.
formula_master.help_basics_active_detail: Enables this formula set for active consultation note parsing.
formula_master.help_basics_default_detail: Marks this formula set as the primary fallback ruleset for all doctor consultations.
formula_master.help_basics_published_detail: Publishes the formula set so it is available live during patient visits.
formula_master.help_numeric_desc: These rules control how numbers typed in the doctor's consultation form (e.g., 30, 200/2, 84/20) are automatically converted into medicine charges and dosage schedules.
formula_master.help_numeric_plain_detail: Used when a doctor types a single standalone number (like "30"). The system recognizes it as Medicine Code 30, sets a flat price (e.g. ₹80), and attaches the default 4-4-4 dosage schedule.
formula_master.help_numeric_single_detail: Used when typing a number with a 1-digit slash suffix (like "200/2"). Here, "200" is the medicine code and "2" is the duration multiplier (e.g., 2 weeks). Total Price = Suffix (2) × Multiplier (₹100) = ₹200.
formula_master.help_numeric_double_detail: Used when typing a number with a 2-digit slash suffix (like "84/20"). "84" is the medicine code and "20" is the quantity. Total Price = Suffix (20) × Multiplier (₹10) = ₹200.
formula_master.help_templates_desc: Dosage templates define how medicine doses are distributed throughout the day (Morning, Afternoon, Night) and what instructions to give the patient.
formula_master.help_templates_code_detail: A short unique code used by rules and alpha codes to apply this exact dosage schedule.
formula_master.help_templates_dose_detail: Defines the time of day the patient should take the medication.
formula_master.help_templates_balls_detail: The number of homeopathic pills or globules to take in each single dose (e.g., 4 balls).
formula_master.help_templates_instructions_detail: Optional directions printed on the prescription (e.g., "Empty stomach" or "After meals").
formula_master.help_alpha_desc: Alpha shortcodes are medical abbreviations (like BD, TDS, QID) typed in the consultation form to quickly set pricing, duration, and dosage.
formula_master.help_alpha_code_detail: The quick text abbreviation typed by the doctor during consultation (e.g., "10/BD").
formula_master.help_alpha_price_detail: Fixed price automatically applied to the prescription when this alpha code is typed.
formula_master.help_alpha_template_detail: Maps the alpha code directly to its timing template (e.g. BD → Morning & Night).
formula_master.help_alpha_days_detail: Customizes or overrides the total prescription duration in days when this code is used.

appointments_trend.title: Appointments Trend
appointments_trend.body: This line graph compares total appointments (teal) with completed consultations (green) across the selected dates. A gap between the two lines means some visits were not completed.

appointment_status.title: Appointment Status
appointment_status.body: This donut chart shows how appointments in the selected period split into Completed, Pending, Cancelled, and Confirmed. The centre shows the completion percentage and completed count.

followup_volume_by_plan.title: Follow-up Volume by Plan
followup_volume_by_plan.body: This bar chart ranks treatment plans by how many pending follow-up checkups they currently have. Longer bars mean more patients are due under that plan.

followup_engagement.title: Follow-up Engagement
followup_engagement.body: This donut chart shows whether due follow-up patients were only notified, or have already booked their next appointment.

schedule_timeline.title: Follow-up Timeline Schedule
schedule_timeline.body: This graph and table group pending follow-ups by due date. The teal line is the number of patients due that day. The number in the tab is how many due dates exist, not how many patients.

age_demographics.title: Age Demographics
age_demographics.body: This donut chart groups unique patients by age band so you can see which life stages visit the clinic most in the selected period.

patient_visit_types.title: Patient Visit Types
patient_visit_types.body: This donut chart compares first-time (new) appointments with repeat visits in the selected period.

family_structuring.title: Family Structuring
family_structuring.body: This donut chart shows how many appointments were booked for a family member versus the primary patient themselves.

payment_status.title: Payment Status
payment_status.body: This donut chart splits bills in the selected period into paid, unpaid, and partial so you can see collection health at a glance.

revenue_volume_trends.title: Revenue & Volume Trends
revenue_volume_trends.body: This chart shows dispensary volume and revenue over time. Green bars are processed prescriptions, amber bars are still pending, and the teal line is revenue in rupees.

inventory_demand.title: Inventory Demand
inventory_demand.body: This ranking shows which medicines were dispensed most in the selected period. Longer bars mean higher demand.

month_wise_comparison.title: Month-wise Comparison
month_wise_comparison.body: This bar chart compares booked appointments with consulted (completed) visits for each month of the selected year. Click a month to see day-wise detail.

daily_booked_vs_consulted.title: Daily Booked vs Consulted
daily_booked_vs_consulted.body: This bar chart shows booked versus consulted appointments for each day of the selected month. Click a day to open the patient-wise list.

daily_slot_appointments.title: Daily Appointments by Slot
daily_slot_appointments.body: This bar chart splits the selected day into morning/evening slots and compares booked versus consulted visits in each slot.

branch_performance.title: Branch Performance
branch_performance.body: This bar chart compares total appointments across clinic branches for the selected period.

treatment_popularity.title: Treatment Popularity
